user_instruction: A noter que si le joueur controle un monstre et si ce joueur a aussi des pets (ressucités / drones) et bien ces pets ne devront pas attaquer le monstre dominé.
accepted_rule: while domination is active, player drones and resurrected allies recognize the dominated monster as allied and do not select or retain it as an attack target
during_domination: attack target allegiance re-evaluated on successful domination; pet stops targeting this monster
after_end: existing return-to-hostile rule retained; ordinary pet target selection applies
player_manual_attacks_other_damage_sourc: not newly decided; specific cases pending
no_change_to: HP statistics skills duration chance energy cooldown and accepted overhead symbol
